opportunities.observation: Pinned Gemma4Attention materializes BF16 QKV, launches fused QKV RMSNorm and RoPE, then separately writes K and V into the FP8 paged cache before Triton decode attention consumes Q and the cache.
opportunities.evidence_scope: google/gemma-4-31B-it@b9ea41a; SGLang v0.5.13@28b095c0; decode c32; H200; local Q32/KV16/d256 and global Q32/KV4/d512
opportunities.resource_signature: small c32 epilogue grids and compulsory intermediate/cache traffic ahead of a memory-intensive paged-attention consumer
competing_explanations: The attention consumer dominates enough that launch/dataflow savings disappear in the full component boundary.
FP8 cache rounding after fused normalization/RoPE exceeds the consumer-output numerical gate.
opportunities.mechanism: One Triton kernel normalizes Q/K/V, applies exact partial/full RoPE, emits Q in consumer layout, and writes K/V directly into their final FP8 paged-cache rows.
opportunities.modifiable_fraction: Four stock pre-attention launches plus their intermediate BF16 traffic; the QKV GEMM and attention kernels remain unchanged.
opportunities.upper_bound: At most the complete stock epilogue/cache-write portion of the measured producer-output-to-consumer boundary.
opportunities.falsifier: A same-process target-H200 call through installed decode_attention_fwd is incorrect or the alternating profiler-off median is not lower.
opportunities.next_measurement: One local and one global exact decode-c32 correctness-bearing component comparison.
